body:
CHIEF DISPOSITION ON THE NFRD BASEBALL COURT: ALL FIVE APPROVED AS PROPOSED. Two additions, one of
them load-bearing. Reserve your paths and start.

1. HOME -- embed-bench, JVM-only, no new module or dependency. APPROVED as the FIRST
   implementation, and say in the document that it is not the final one. Bench is where
   diagnostics live and adding a module before we know the shape would be premature. But if NFRD
   becomes the primary corpus this outgrows a bench project, and I would rather that be written
   down now than discovered as an argument later.

2. private[bench] VOCABULARY -- APPROVED, and it is the right instinct. NFRD-specific types must
   not reach a public API before we know whether they generalise across corpora. Everything about
   today says a type that escapes early gets frozen by its consumers.

3. AGGREGATE-ONLY GIT POSTURE -- APPROVED, and this is the best decision in the proposal. Pinning
   two aggregate manifest digests plus three non-participant stimulus hashes, with participant
   IDs, per-file hashes and bytes staying external, means THE REPOSITORY CAN VERIFY THE CORPUS
   WITHOUT CONTAINING IT. That satisfies the privacy question and the owner's "not necessarily
   redistributing" posture in one move.

   NAME THE TRADE-OFF IN THE DOCUMENT: aggregate digests tell you THAT the corpus changed, not
   WHICH file changed. Per-file hashes would be better forensics and would leak participant
   structure -- how many files, and their identity. You have chosen privacy over forensics and
   that is right, but a reader deserves to know it was a choice.

4. FROZEN 57/28/28 HASH-RANKED SPLIT, BEFORE TRANSCRIPT PARSING -- APPROVED, AND THIS IS THE
   METHODOLOGICAL HEART OF THE PROPOSAL. A split chosen after seeing the transcripts is not a
   split, it is a selection, and every number computed downstream of it inherits that. Freezing
   before parsing is pre-registration discipline and nobody asked you to do it.

   THE ADDITION, AND IT IS REQUIRED: RECORD THE RANKING METHOD AND ANY SEED SO A THIRD PARTY CAN
   REGENERATE THE SPLIT. "Frozen" means nothing to an outsider unless they can reproduce it --
   otherwise it is a claim that you froze it, which is exactly the class of unverifiable assertion
   this project spends its days removing. The split is the one artifact where reproducibility is
   not optional, because a reader cannot check any result without it.

5. SEPARATION FROM THE GENERAL ADMITTED-STORY LOADER -- APPROVED. A diagnostic verifier and a
   production loader have different obligations and merging them would give the loader the
   verifier's assumptions.

AND THE THINGS YOU DID WITHOUT BEING ASKED, which are why this got approved in one pass rather
than three: the Observation/Derivation/Unknown ledger; refusing traversal and symlink escape in
the filesystem adapter; exact pair equality with every byte and size verified; keeping it
Origin.Diagnostic; and stating plainly that there is NO hand-authored Baseball graph and NO claim
of a scientific result. That last sentence is the one that will matter in three weeks when someone
quotes a number from this.

Reserve and go.
